summary: What was checked: 5 groups of automated checks on the data files, every API endpoint against the contract, and the demo path for Bangladesh and Punjab (5 of 5 passed).
How well it held up: the per-region ratio (B1) was chosen by held-out agreement (mean Lin's CCC {'B1': 0.9417, 'LightGBM': 0.9351}); the 90% bands covered 0.916 of held-out weekly totals.
Where it is weak: values before 2012 are modeled and whole unusually-strong seasons may be flagged only at their edges. This run uses downloaded FIRMS observations.
